sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 343 (all pages via campsitePaging.do, 44 of 45 campsites parsed)

values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead, same day included. A 1-night campsite stay can be booked within 3 days of arrival. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away before registering again. The registering camper must be 18 or older.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/burnham-point-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=343 (Booking Window: Campsite 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; 'Looking to reserve a campsite for just 1 night? If you make your reservation within 3 days of your arrival you can book a 1-night stay online or through the Call Center'; LENGTH OF STAY 'maximum of 14 continuous nights ... must leave the site and facility for 48 hours'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The park says its electric sites have 20-amp service, while the ReserveAmerica site list tags 26 sites 30-amp and 6 sites 50-amp; 32 of the 44 parsed sites have electric. No water or sewer at any site.

hookups.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/burnham-point-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=343 ('There are no water or sewer services available at any site. Electric sites are equipped with 20amp service.') + ReserveAmerica site list ('Electric Hookup available: 30 amp' 26, '50 amp' 6, 'Electric Hookup - no' 12), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 45 campsites, lightly wooded. ReserveAmerica lists most equipment lengths at 20 ft (24 sites); only 8 are listed longer (5 at 30 ft, 2 at 40 ft back-in, one at 30 ft). The 12 sites tagged near the water have no length or electric.

sites.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/burnham-point-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=343 ('Campsite (45)'; 'lightly-wooded campsites') + ReserveAmerica site list (Equip length/Driveway '20 Back-In' 24, '30 Back-In' 5, '40 Back-In' 2, '30' 1, blank 12; 'Near Water' 12), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/burnham-point-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=343 ('The park offers campsites, showers, dumping stations'; Services and Amenities 'Dump Station', 'Showers'), read 2026-10-21
